reviews.title: Another Great Logitech Keyboard
reviews.comment:
This is an incredible keyboard.
Prior to this, I was using the Logitech Wave, but I wanted a cute and simple mechanical keyboard.
I work from home, working up to 9 hours a day and my setup includes a Macbook Pro.
This keyboard syncs quickly, types smoothly, is quiet and overall looks so beautiful on my desk.
Compared to other mechanical keyboards, such as the Aura which I have at the office, this mechanical keyboard has smoother and lower keycaps. Therefore, it is quitter and does not hurt my hands over time.
I would definitely recommend! Definitely worth the money.
reviews.author: Jennie Garcia

reviews.title: Beautiful, well built and comfortable to type on.
reviews.comment:
Wow...Logitech has done it again.  This keyboard is amazing.  Sturdy, well-built, and a dream to type on.  The purple color is just beautiful, and I honestly didn't expect it to be this nice to type on.  I wish it were a bit quieter, but this is a minor complaint as I absolutely love this keyboard.  It came with 50% charge and was easy to install the software on my Mac.  I've honestly been finding excuses to get on my computer all day just so I can type on it!
UPDATE:  After having and using the keyboard for a few months, I can't believe that it is listed as a frequently returned item.  I love it so much, I'm thinking of buying a second one to use in my classroom at school.
reviews.author: Tracey Smith

reviews.title: Best Keyboard Ever
reviews.comment: I have gone through an extreme amount of keyboards trying to find one I like and this one has ended that search! This is the most satisfying and comfortable keyboard I have ever used. It has a nice sound as you type and feels heavy which to me signifies quality. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Jacob Isherwood

reviews.title: Surprisingly good wireless keyboard!
reviews.comment:
The media could not be loaded.  https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/D1Y2AgGh8EL.mp4 https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/61Z5P8kGfqL._SY256.jpg I was pretty hesitant to buy this keyboard since I haven’t always had the best experience with Logitech. It ended up being way better than I expected and is now my main keyboard. I originally grabbed it because my old one broke in the middle of a game jam and this was the fastest wireless option I could get delivered.
I actually really like the stock linear Marble switches. They sound good and the keys are light and easy to press, which feels great for both typing and gaming (at least to me).
My only real complaint is the space bar. It has a noticeably more hallow sound compared to the rest of the keys, and it can be a little distracting since it stands out so much. I included a couple videos in hopes of being able to pick up this sound difference but it sounds more jarring in person.
As for build quality, I think it’s perfectly fine for normal desk use. I saw a lot of reviews mentioning flex because it doesn’t have a metal backplate like some other keyboards in this price range. Unless you’re intentionally trying to twist it, though, you won't notice any flex during regular use. It might be more of an issue if you plan to use it on your lap or on a soft surface and tend to type with a heavy hand, but on a desk it feels solid to me.
reviews.author: Robert H.

reviews.title: Great Keyboard for All
reviews.comment: Love love love this keyboard. The color matches the Logitech lavender mouse pad perfectly. I share an office with my tech geek husband and he liked it so much, he got himself a white one as well. The sound is satisfying but not too clacky. I like the full size and my husband loves the accompanying app you can use for customization. I have just used the keyboard as it came and also love it. Essentially, I think this is a great keyboard for office use, gaming use, tech nerds, tech illiterate people, and everyone in between. Just a good all around keyboard. Totally worth the price point in my opinion.
